# PM033: ready-queue-low

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | PM |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | advisory |
| tier | universal |
| scope | repo |
| fix | manual |
| polarity | P+ |
| must_measure | false |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

The ready queue holds fewer doable tickets than `[pm] ready_min`.

Advisory only: it never fails the gate. A `ready_min` of 0 turns the rule
off.

## Remedy

Plan the next cycle (run `frob cycle plan`) or triage the backlog so more tickets become
doable, or lower `[pm] ready_min` in `frob.toml`.

## Examples

### PM033 ready queue below the order point / One doable ticket with ready_min 4 fires with the counts #1 (line 9) (fire)

```text
ready_min 4
task a
```

### PM033 ready queue below the order point / Four doable tickets with ready_min 4 is silent #2 (line 16) (clean)

```text
ready_min 4
task a
task b
task c
task d
```

### PM033 ready queue below the order point / Tickets in progress are not ready #3 (line 26) (fire)

```text
ready_min 2
task a
task b state=in_progress
```

### PM033 ready queue below the order point / Epics are not ready #4 (line 34) (fire)

```text
ready_min 2
epic e
task a
```

### PM033 ready queue below the order point / A ready_min of 0 is off #5 (line 42) (clean)

```text
ready_min 0
```
